chapter_theme: The sun in the body (பிண்டாதித்தன்): when the malams are destroyed and the inner current runs up the channel, a wide light shines; those who find where that sun settles know themselves and fall silent, and the poet's love melts toward those who know where it lies hidden.

1985.reading: Standing, sitting, lying and walking, he kept within the thought of Nandi; when the malams are destroyed and the current runs up the channel, the wide light is seen shining in victory.
1985.nuance: The four postures say the practice is constant, not set to a seat. கன்றாய is unclear (become a calf, or worn); மலங்கன் is likely மலங்கள். குழல்வழி (the tube's way) is traditionally the central channel, and the spreading light the inner sun the chapter is named for.

1986.reading: Those who have found the place where the sun runs and settles and can practise it know themselves; all the babble the divided world utters, they put to rest with that sun.
1986.nuance: ஆதித்தன் ஓடி அடங்கும் இடம் is taken as the point where the solar breath (the right channel) comes to rest. The last line can also mean that the babblers themselves subside with the setting sun, that is, die.

1987.reading: No one knows the ford where it lies plugged after drawing out, going forth and circling the world; for those who know that ford, my inmost love lies melting.
1987.nuance: The subject is not named: in this chapter it is the inner sun, and many take it as the breath, which goes out, ranges and is then locked in (சொருகி). உருகிக் கிடக்கும் echoes சொருகிக் கிடக்கும்: the light lies locked, the poet's love lies melted, for those who know.

links.note: Both put the decisive event in the குழல்வழி, the tube or central channel: in 754 the Dancer stands there for those who see the feet, in 1985 a victorious light shines there once the malams are killed.

source_issues: 1985: மலங்கன் is likely a misprint for மலங்கள்.
1986: the line break falls inside ஆதித்தனோடே, so line 3 runs long and line 4 is short.
